issue.title: Task relations: 🪢 LINKS, a generated 🪢 LINKED FROM mirror, and ~ / ~~ capture
issue.description: Bryan can relate any task to any other task with an optional label, from Bob Mac Capture (`~` / `~~`) and from the Obsidian Task Card (`l` / `⇧L`). The relation is authored once on the source's `🪢 **LINKS:**` line, and a generated `🪢 **LINKED FROM:**` line on the target always converges to it. Live chips render both ends correctly, and relations never block, promote, consume, schedule, stamp, or route anything.
